ayahs.textEnglish: CONSIDER the fig and the olive,

ayahs.textArabic: لَقَدْ خَلَقْنَا الْاِنْسَانَ فِيْٓ اَحْسَنِ تَقْوِيْمٍۖ
ayahs.textEnglish: Verily, We create man in the best conformation;
and thereafter We reduce him to the lowest of low

ayahs.textArabic: اِلَّا الَّذِيْنَ اٰمَنُوْا وَعَمِلُوا الصّٰلِحٰتِ فَلَهُمْ اَجْرٌ غَيْرُ مَمْنُوْنٍۗ
ayahs.textLatin: Illal-lażīna āmanū wa ‘amiluṣ-ṣāliḥāti falahum ajrun gairu mamnūn(in).
ayahs.textEnglish: excepting only such as attain to faith and do good works: and theirs shall be a reward unending!
What, then, [O man,] could henceforth cause thee to give the lie to this moral law?
Is not God the most just of judges?
